LESSON: FISHING IN KENYA VICTORIA TURKANA NAIVASHA TANA AND RIVER ATHI

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Resources and Economic Activities
Topic 3.3: Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is fishing important in our country?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify main inland fishing grounds in Kenya
2. explain contribution of fishing to the economy of Kenya

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify main inland fishing grounds in Kenya
   In simple words: practise until you can identify main inland fishing grounds in Kenya. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain contribution of fishing to the economy of Kenya
   In simple words: practise until you can explain contribution of fishing to the economy of Kenya. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi in the examples.
2. Explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi.
4. Show that you can: identify main inland fishing grounds in Kenya

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Brainstorm on the main inland fishing grounds in Kenya using digital resources/print media,
2. Draw a map of Kenya showing the main inland fishing grounds,
3. Engage with a resource person to discuss the contribution of fishing to the economy of Kenya and report in class,
4. Self-Efficacy: Learners show attention to detail as they discuss in groups methods of inland fishing in Kenya and report in class.
5. Citizenship: Learners demonstrate creativity as they develop posters, in pairs, on the importance of fishing in Kenya and share with members of the community. Values:

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify main inland fishing grounds in Kenya
2. explain contribution of fishing to the economy of Kenya

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
